name: Bartek Witański
role: Art director, co-founder of Blank Studio
short: Graphic designer specialising in wayfinding systems. Co-founder of Blank Studio, whose work for public spaces has won the Red Dot, iF and European Design Awards. Lectures and leads workshops at art and design schools across Poland.
bio: Bartek Witański is actively involved in many areas of graphic design, but specialises primarily in the design of wayfinding systems.

He is a co-founder and designer at Blank Studio, one of the few companies in Poland and Europe that specialises exclusively in designing complex wayfinding systems for a variety of public spaces. The studio’s projects have earned recognition in numerous industry competitions, including the Red Dot Communication Design Award, iF Design Award, European Design Award, German Design Award, Golden Pin, Joseph Binder Award, the Polish Graphic Design Award, Project of the Year, SEGD and many others.

In addition to designing and managing the studio, Bartek shares his knowledge by lecturing and leading thematic workshops at the Polish-Japanese Academy of Information Technology in Warsaw, the University of Arts in Poznań and the Academy of Fine Arts in Katowice.
